criteria.metric: Euclidean distance from ee_site to target_position at terminal state
criteria.rationale: Adapted from Meta-World sawyer_reach_v3 success criterion: reach_dist <= 0.05 m (actual_study: metaworld/envs/sawyer_reach_v3.py lines 74-98).

source_refs.specific_reference: metaworld/envs/sawyer_reach_v3.py, evaluate_state, lines 74-98: success is reach_dist <= 0.05.

criteria.metric: Absolute error of joint7 position from target_opening at terminal state
criteria.rationale: proposed: 3 mm tolerance on a 35 mm travel slide gripper (~8.6% of full range), consistent with position-controlled actuator settling.

source_refs.specific_reference: Proposed 3 mm tolerance on joint7 slide position (35 mm range); no direct Meta-World gripper position criterion exists.

criteria.metric: Absolute error of joint6 position from target_angle at terminal state
criteria.rationale: proposed: 0.05 rad (~2.9 deg) wrist-roll positioning tolerance for grasp alignment tasks (pick-place, bin-picking).

source_refs.specific_reference: Proposed 0.05 rad tolerance on joint6 wrist-roll; derived from grasp alignment requirements in mw_pick_place and mw_bin_picking.

criteria.metric: Ordered trajectory matching: ee_site visits all provided waypoints in order; terminal error to final waypoint
criteria.rationale: proposed: 0.05 m terminal error at final waypoint, consistent with Meta-World reach/push/pick-place thresholds. Ordered traversal required for wall-routing tasks (mw_push_wall, mw_pick_place_wall, mw_door_open, mw_faucet_open, mw_dial_turn, mw_lever_pull).

source_refs.specific_reference: metaworld/envs/sawyer_push_wall_v3.py evaluate_state and sawyer_pick_place_wall_v3.py evaluate_state: ordered routing around obstacle required before terminal placement.

criteria.metric: Euclidean distance from ee_site to tool_target_position at terminal state
criteria.rationale: proposed: 0.05 m terminal ee_site error at tool_target_position, consistent with Meta-World push/button/handle/drawer thresholds.

source_refs.specific_reference: metaworld/envs/sawyer_push_v3.py evaluate_state lines 88-112; sawyer_button_press_v3.py evaluate_state lines 60-82; sawyer_handle_press_v3.py evaluate_state lines 64-86.

criteria.metric: Peak contact normal force between ee geoms and scene object during displacement phase
criteria.rationale: proposed: at least 0.5 N peak contact normal force confirms physical contact was made during the displacement. Threshold is conservative for a lightweight tabletop object.

source_refs.specific_reference: Proposed 0.5 N minimum peak contact force to confirm physical contact during push/press/sweep motions.
